programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show

programme.desc: S06 E04 — Telizza & Shai Frustrated by several failed attempts to video chat with Shai, Telizza turns to Nev and Max to uncover the truth.
programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show

programme.desc: S07 E39 — Cherie & Avion Cherie enlists the help of Nev and Justin to find out more about the man she sent sexy pictures to.
programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show

programme.desc: S07 E22 — Chelsea & Lennie Nev and co-host Tallulah Willis help Chelsea, a young woman who is in love with a reality TV star; digging for the truth only reveals Chelsea has her own secrets.
programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show

programme.desc: S07 E25 — Dallas & Safari Model Dallas has had his sights set on sexy Safari ever since she slid into his DMs, but despite flirty promises, she won't meet; Nev and co-host Tallulah Willis take Dallas on a wild ride as they hunt for Safari.
programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show

programme.desc: S06 E06 — Mecca & Tanner An 18-year-old wants to connect with the guy she has been in love with for five years, but he may be using her pictures to catfish others.
programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show

programme.desc: S07 E12 — Nina & Jon Nina is a sexy webcam model who's considering leaving her husband for a client, who is a big spender, she has fallen in love with online.
programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show

programme.desc: S06 E16 — Robert & Ashleigh Robert has lived with paralysis since he was a teenager; he meets Ashleigh online, and they fall in love; with news he may not have much longer to live, Robert asks Nev and Max to bring Ashleigh to him.
programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show

programme.desc: S07 E08 — Mandy & Jose Mandy is in love with a guy that gives her everything except the truth; Mandy's son has had enough and calls in Nev and Max for help, but following a trail of clues only takes them all deeper down the rabbit hole.
programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show

programme.title: The Wayans Bros.

programme.title: The Wayans Bros.

programme.desc: S30 E22 — Grand Prize Spectacular, Funny Faces, and Boneheads on Parade The two $100,000 winners of Season 30 go head-to-head to compete for the grand prize; a dad who discovers his toddler has thrown his money and credit cards in the toilet; a toddler handcuffs his baby brother's legs together.
programme.title: America's Funniest Home Videos

programme.desc: S03 E08 — Sydney & Domonhic Sydney and Dominic have been dating for three years; it was perfect in the beginning, but everything changed a year ago and Sydney is no longer allowed around Dominic's family or friends, and she's blocked on social media; she wants to know why.
programme.title: Help! I'm in a Secret Relationship!

programme.desc: S03 E14 — Tangy & Jenny Tangy and Jenny built a beautiful life together with Jenny's five children; Tangy wants to propose and become a legal guardian, but she can't until she figures out why Jenny is hiding her from everyone else in her life.
programme.title: Help! I'm in a Secret Relationship!

programme.desc: S03 E24 — Jake & Sarah Jake believes Sarah is special from their first meeting; the relationship moves quickly, and he can't imagine life with anyone else; but before he takes the next step, he needs to find out why Sarah's hiding him.
programme.title: Help! I'm in a Secret Relationship!

programme.desc: S03 E01 — Tirelle and DeeDee DeeDee's been hiding Tirelle for the entirety of their five-year relationship, and he's broken up with her in the past for not letting him meet her friends and family; they're now back together, but DeeDee's still hiding Tirelle.
programme.title: Help! I'm in a Secret Relationship!

programme.desc: S03 E21 — Rolando & Joshua Rolando leaves everything behind for love, moving to Seattle to build a life with Joshua; two-and-a-half years in, Joshua is still hiding Rolando from his family and his past in California; Rolando wants answers.
programme.title: Help! I'm in a Secret Relationship!

programme.desc: S03 E19 — Matt & Danny Matt and Danny went from long distance to no distance in a matter of weeks; they're only ten months into their relationship, but Matt is ready to move in with Danny, but there's a problem, he's being hidden.
programme.title: Help! I'm in a Secret Relationship!

programme.title: Boundless
programme.desc: Adventure junkies Simon Donato and Paul "Turbo" Trebilcock try to prove that boundaries are meant to be broken as they test their limits in some of the world's toughest endurance races. Donato, who holds a doctorate in geology, is the brains of the duo and a self-proclaimed nomad. Trebilcock, a dedicated athlete with a background in running, is considered the heart of the team. Together, they participate in competitions that include a seven-day race through volcanic terrain in Iceland, a 46-mile foot race with obstacles, and a 142-mile run through Cambodian jungles. From running, biking, skiing, swimming and climbing, their love for the rush coupled with their undeniable stamina makes it a wild ride with a few cuts and bruised egos along the way. Endurance athletes Rory Bosio and Hunter McIntyre join the team beginning in Season 3.

programme.desc: Adventure junkies Simon Donato and Paul "Turbo" Trebilcock try to prove that boundaries are meant to be broken as they test their limits in some of the world's toughest endurance races. Donato, who holds a doctorate in geology, is the brains of the duo and a self-proclaimed nomad. Trebilcock, a dedicated athlete with a background in running, is considered the heart of the team. Together, they participate in competitions that include a seven-day race through volcanic terrain in Iceland, a 46-mile foot race with obstacles, and a 142-mile run through Cambodian jungles. From running, biking, skiing, swimming and climbing, their love for the rush coupled with their undeniable stamina makes it a wild ride with a few cuts and bruised egos along the way. programme.title: Prem Classics

programme.desc: 2016: West Ham United v Manchester United Enjoy the greatest Premier League game for each of the league's 47 clubs, as voted for by fans. Here, for West Ham, their 3-2 win over Man Utd in May 2016 in their final game at Upton Park.
programme.title: Premier League Fan's Vote

programme.desc: 2010: Wigan Athletic v Arsenal Enjoy the greatest Premier League game for each of the league's 47 clubs, as voted for by fans. Here, for Wigan Athletic, their late comeback 3-2 win over Arsenal in April 2010.
programme.title: Premier League Fan's Vote

programme.desc: 1997: Arsenal v Wimbledon Relive a classic Premier League match. Here, Arsenal host Wimbledon at Highbury back in 1997 on what would be a memorable afternoon for the Dons.
programme.title: The Premier League's Greatest Games

programme.desc: Best of Wenger: 2009, Liverpool v Arsenal A chance to relive a classic match from the Premier League. Here, Liverpool meet Arsenal in an eight-goal thriller at Anfield in 2009 that saw a certain Andrei Arshavin steal the show.
programme.title: The Premier League's Greatest Games

programme.desc: 2001/02 Classic action from the Premier League.
programme.title: Best Premier League Goals

programme.desc: Andy Cole Series profiling some of the greatest players to grace the Barclays Premier League. Here the focus is on former Newcastle United and Manchester United striker Andy Cole.
programme.title: Premier League Legends

programme.desc: Alan Shearer The Premier League's all-time leading goalscorer, hear from Alan Shearer about his phenomenal strike record in England's top flight, as he looks back on his esteemed career.
programme.title: Premier League 100

programme.desc: 2016: AFC Bournemouth v Liverpool Enjoy the greatest Premier League game for each of the league's 47 clubs, as voted for by fans. Here, for Bournemouth, their stunning 4-3 comeback win over Liverpool back in December 2016.
programme.title: Premier League Fan's Vote

programme.desc: 2002: Birmingham City v Aston Villa Enjoy the greatest Premier League game for each of the league's 47 clubs, as voted for by fans. Here, for Birmingham City, the 3-0 win over rivals Aston Villa in September 2002.
programme.title: Premier League Fan's Vote

programme.desc: 2000: Bradford City v Liverpool Enjoy the greatest Premier League game for each of the league's 47 clubs, as voted for by fans. Here, for Bradford City, their 1-0 win over Liverpool at Valley Parade back in May 2000.

programme.desc: 2008: Aston Villa v Birmingham City Enjoy the greatest Premier League game for each of the league's 47 clubs, as voted for by fans. Here, for Aston Villa, their 5-1 hammering of rivals Birmingham City back in April 2008.

programme.desc: 2005/06 Classic action from the Premier League.

programme.title: Premier League Legends

programme.desc: David James David James reflects on the journey that saw him keep 169 Premier League clean sheets for five clubs, from the weight of expectation at Liverpool to breaking records at Portsmouth.
programme.title: Premier League 100

programme.desc: S6 E10 — The Ipswich Way From the trailblazing success of Sir Alf Ramsey's league champions to Sir Bobby Robson's unforgettable FA Cup and UEFA Cup triumphs, this is the story of one of English football's most cherished clubs. We celebrate the remarkable highs, the resilience through changing times, and George Burley's extraordinary achievement in guiding Ipswich Town to a fifth-place finish in their first Premier League season.
programme.title: Premier League Stories

programme.desc: S6 E11 — The Tigers Return Hull City's return to the Premier League is the latest chapter in a story built on resilience, ambition and belief. We look back on the club's previous adventures in the top-flight, reliving the moments that shaped its identity before looking ahead to an exciting new era. Joining the Tigers at their pre-season training camp in Slovenia, we go behind the scenes to discover how the club is preparing for the challenges ahead.
programme.title: Premier League Stories

programme.desc: S6 E12 — Coventry Rising We follow Coventry City as they prepare for a long-awaited return to the Premier League, ending a 25-year absence from English football's top flight. With exclusive access during the club's pre-season training camp in Málaga, we go behind the scenes as players and staff build towards a landmark campaign filled with anticipation and expectation.
programme.title: Premier League Stories

programme.desc: S6 E14 — Petr Cech One of the Premier League's greatest-ever goalkeepers, Petr Čech's career was nearly changed forever by the horrific head injury he suffered in 2006. We sit down with him to discuss his remarkable recovery and journey back to the very top, before discovering how his competitive drive has continued, with the Czech shot-stopper swapping football for a new challenge playing Ice Hockey.
programme.title: Premier League Stories

programme.desc: S6 E15 — Amad Diallo From his early years in Ivory Coast to leaving Africa for Europe, Amad Diallo's journey has been one of talent, determination and sacrifice. After making his breakthrough in Italy, his potential earned him a dream move to Manchester United, where he has fought to establish himself on the Premier League stage. We follow Amad's remarkable rise and the journey that has taken him from humble beginnings to the heights of Old Trafford.
programme.title: Premier League Stories

programme.desc: S6 E16 — John Stones John Stones has experienced almost everything the game can offer; from the pressure of the biggest stage to the injuries and setbacks that have tested him along the way. After more than a decade at the heart of the Premier League, winning its biggest honours and helping redefine the role of a modern defender, he now takes his career in a new direction.
programme.title: Premier League Stories

programme.desc: S6 E17 — Granit Xhaka From his family's courageous journey in search of a better future to becoming one of Europe's most respected midfielders, this is the story of Granit Xhaka. We chart his rise through the game, the highs and lows of a career that tested his resilience, and the turbulent relationship with Arsenal supporters that ultimately became one of football's greatest redemption stories.
programme.title: Premier League Stories

programme.desc: S6 E18 — Roberto Mancini From a celebrated playing career in Italy to becoming the man who transformed Manchester City into Premier League champions, Roberto Mancini's footballing life has been filled with triumph, drama and unforgettable characters. PL Stories explores his fiery relationship with Mario Balotelli, 'that' extraordinary final-day victory over QPR, and the deep friendship he shared with the late Gianluca Vialli.
programme.title: Premier League Stories

programme.desc: S6 E20 — The Evolution of Goalkeepers Once the last line of defence, today's goalkeeper is expected to be so much more. From sweeper-keepers to playing out under pressure, we explore the innovations, characters and changing demands that have revolutionised one of football's most fascinating positions.
programme.title: Premier League Stories

programme.desc: S6 E21 — Marcus Stewart: The Fight of My Life Ipswich Town legend and former Sunderland striker Marcus Stewart built a career on taking on some of football's toughest challenges. Now, he faces a very different battle; one that has changed his life beyond the pitch and revealed a strength and determination far greater than anything football demanded of him.
programme.title: Premier League Stories

programme.desc: S6 E23 — Aston Villa 1992/93: Behind the First Season Aston Villa's 1992/93 season had all the ingredients of a defining football story. Through special behind-the-scenes footage, PL Stories takes viewers inside Ron Atkinson's Villa, revealing the characters, camaraderie and mounting pressure of a gripping title challenge. From the dressing room to the drama on the pitch, this is the inside story of Villa's pursuit of the first Premier League crown.
programme.title: Premier League Stories

programme.desc: S6 E24 — Mikel Arteta We explore Mikel Arteta's impact at Arsenal and the managerial approach behind his success, reflecting on how his upbringing and football education in the Basque region shaped his thinking. We examine his tactics, how he develops players and the standards he sets throughout the club. We look at the key decisions that have turned Arsenal into Premier League champions.
programme.title: Premier League Stories

programme.title: Password
programme.desc: Starring Jimmy Fallon and hosted by Keke Palmer, the iconic word-guessing game features celebrities teaming up with everyday contestants. These teams play a modern and refreshed version of the game that's inspired by classic Password, Password Plus, Super Password and the viral celebrity Password games seen on The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon. Players compete over three rounds of gameplay, taking turns trying to get their partner to guess the password using one-word clues. The team with the most points after two rounds heads to the bonus round, where they have 60 seconds to get the celebrity guests to correctly guess 10 passwords for a chance to win as much as $25,000.

programme.title: Suits
programme.desc: Big-time Manhattan corporate lawyer Harvey Specter and his team, which includes Donna Paulsen, Louis Litt, and Alex Williams, are launched into a play for power when a new partner joins the firm. Charlie is one of the five kids who find a lucky ticket and goes on a tour of Wonka's chocolate factory.
programme.title: Charlie and the Chocolate Factory

programme.desc: Creepy fairy tale following the fortunes of a young orphan who becomes embroiled in a supernatural adventure. Brought up on his kindly grandmother's scary stories about witches, he stumbles on a real coven while on holiday. Overhearing their plans to capture all the children in Britain, he sets out to stop them, remaining undeterred throughout - even when he has been turned into a mouse.
programme.title: The Witches

programme.desc: Mr Fox plots one more raid on farmers Boggis, Bunce and Bean before he becomes a responsible father figure.
programme.title: Fantastic Mr. Fox

programme.desc: Stranded in the wilderness, a mule deer and a domesticated bear try to make their way back to the safety of a town preserve before a hunter catches them.
programme.title: Open Season

programme.desc: A young boy searches for a way to gain the affections of his dream-girl. In his quest he learns that in order to succeed he must uncover the story of the grumpy but nature-loving Lorax.
programme.title: Dr. Seuss' the Lorax

programme.desc: A clever bounty-hunting pig must return a dancing elephant to a Las Vegas circus to collect $1 million. However, when the mission goes sideways, he soon realises that no amount of money is worth losing his newfound friends.
programme.title: Hitpig!

programme.desc: Inventor Flint Lockwood dreams of discovering an idea that will change people's lives forever, and after several misguided attempts he may just have done it. Flint has invented a machine that can turn water into delicious food, and, when his first demonstration accidentally sends the machine shooting into the clouds, cheeseburgers begin raining down from the sky.
programme.title: Cloudy With a Chance of Meatballs

programme.desc: Discovering that his most famous machine is now creating animal/vegetable hybrids, inventor Flint Lockwood and his friends venture forth to save the world from tacodiles, shrimpanzees and other creatures.
programme.title: Cloudy With a Chance of Meatballs 2

programme.desc: Fired from the Anti-Villain League, Gru travels to Freedonia to meet his long-lost twin brother. The siblings soon find themselves in an uneasy alliance to take down Balthazar Bratt, a former 1980s child star who wants to take down the world.
programme.title: Despicable Me 3

programme.desc: On a mission to find a new master to serve, three Minions meet Scarlet Overkill, the world's first female super-villain.
programme.title: Minions

programme.desc: When young adventurer Sean Anderson receives a coded distress signal from an uncharted island, he sets out to find it and rescue its lone inhabitant before seismic shockwaves force the island under the sea and bury its treasures forever.
programme.title: Journey 2: The Mysterious Island

programme.desc: A woman of unsettling appearance and magical powers enters the household of the recently widowed Mr Brown and attempts to tame his seven exceedingly badly behaved children. Having already driven away 17 previous nannies, the children are certain that they will have no trouble with Nanny McPhee, but as she takes control, they notice that their vile behaviour now leads swiftly and magically to rather startling consequences.
programme.title: Nanny McPhee

programme.desc: With her husband away at war, harried mother Isabel Green attempts to raise her kids and look after her family farm. The enigmatic Nanny McPhee arrives to assist her as Isabel deals with her sister's spoiled children along with her own.
programme.title: Nanny McPhee & the Big Bang

programme.desc: Daddy Warbucks opens his estate to a spunky orphan in this adaptation of the popular comic strip and hit Broadway show.
programme.title: Annie

programme.desc: Reincarnated as different dogs over the course of five decades, a lovable and devoted canine keeps reuniting with the original owner who cared for it as a young golden retriever puppy.
programme.title: A Dog's Purpose

programme.desc: After moving to New York City, kung fu prodigy Li Fong enters a karate competition -- but his skills alone aren't enough. With help from Mr. Han and Daniel LaRusso, he soon learns to merge two styles into one for the ultimate martial arts showdown.
programme.title: Karate Kid: Legends

programme.desc: Migo is a friendly Yeti who discovers something that he didn't know existed: a human. When his fellow villagers refuse to believe him, Migo embarks on an epic journey to find the mysterious creature that can put him back in good graces.
programme.title: Small Foot

programme.desc: Dracula, who operates a high-end resort away from the human world, goes into overprotective mode when a boy discovers the resort and falls for the count's teenage daughter.
programme.title: Hotel Transylvania

programme.desc: Concerned that his half-human grandson isn't showing his vampire side, Dracula decides to put his grandson through 'monster' boot camp. Then, Dracula's father unexpectedly pays a visit.
programme.title: Hotel Transylvania 2

programme.desc: Mavis surprises Dracula with plans for a fun-filled summer voyage on a monster cruise. As the pack starts enjoying colossal buffets and exotic excursions, Drac finds himself falling for the ship's intriguing but dangerous captain. He soon learns that trying to balance family, friends and romance might just be too much to handle. Even for the world's most powerful vampire.
programme.title: Hotel Transylvania 3: A Monster Vacation

programme.desc: When Shaun decides to take the day off and have some fun, he gets more than he bargained for. A mix-up with the farmer, a caravan and a very steep hill lead Shaun and the flock to the big city, and it's up to Shaun to return everyone home safely.
programme.title: Shaun the Sheep Movie

programme.desc: When an alien possessing strange powers crash-lands near Mossy Bottom Farm, Shaun the Sheep quickly makes a new friend. Together they must run from a dangerous organisation who wants to capture the intergalactic visitor.
programme.title: A Shaun the Sheep Movie: Farmageddon

programme.desc: Peter Rabbit and his three sisters -- Flopsy, Mopsy and Cotton-Tail -- enjoy spending their days in Mr. McGregor's vegetable garden. When one of McGregor's relatives suddenly moves in, he's less than thrilled to discover a family of rabbits in his new home. A battle of wills soon breaks out as the new owner hatches scheme after scheme to get rid of Peter -- a resourceful rabbit who proves to be a worthy and wily opponent.
programme.title: Peter Rabbit

programme.desc: A woman of unsettling appearance and magical powers enters the household of the recently widowed Mr Brown and attempts to tame his seven exceedingly badly behaved children. Having already driven away 17 previous nannies, the children are certain that they will have no trouble with Nanny McPhee, but as she takes control, they notice that their vile behaviour now leads swiftly and magically to rather startling consequences.
programme.title: Nanny McPhee

programme.desc: With her husband away at war, harried mother Isabel Green attempts to raise her kids and look after her family farm. The enigmatic Nanny McPhee arrives to assist her as Isabel deals with her sister's spoiled children along with her own.
programme.title: Nanny McPhee & the Big Bang

programme.desc: Demonised as the Wicked Witch of the West, Elphaba lives in exile, while Glinda resides at the palace in Emerald City. As an angry mob rises against the Wicked Witch, she'll need to reunite with Glinda to transform herself, and all of Oz, for good.
programme.title: Wicked: For Good

programme.desc: A lonely boy-ghost befriends the young daughter of a ghost hunter. A grasping heiress calls in the exorcist to clear out the spooks and gain access to the treasures supposedly hidden in the lonely mansion. Father and daughter discover that Casper is not the only spirit haunting the house and find themselves caught up in an adventure.
programme.title: Casper

programme.desc: Grown-up Peter Pan has to return to Neverland to rediscover his true identity in order to rescue his children from the clutches of the evil Captain Hook. Peter has grown up into a workaholic executive but takes time off for a holiday in London. Once there, his children are kidnapped by Hook, and Peter must throw off his corporate image and go back to Neverland to save his children.
programme.title: Hook

programme.desc: Set in a lawless, post-apocalyptic wilderness. To retrieve his camel train, hero Max enters the seedy, savage, rough-hewn precincts of Bartertown. Forced to fight for his possessions, he breaks the only rule of the city and is banished. In the desert, he is rescued by a tribe of feral children who see him as a prophesied saviour.
programme.title: Mad Max Beyond Thunderdome

programme.desc: Following the death of a local diver, a New York palaeontologist is sent out to help the local fisheries warden investigate the case.
programme.title: Lake Placid

programme.desc: Filmmaker Terri Flores is travelling deep in the Amazon jungle looking for a forgotten tribe. Terri and her crew, which includes an anthropologist and a cameraman, come across Paul, who is stranded on the riverbank. He offers to help them find the tribe, but his secretive behaviour puts everyone on edge. They realise too late that he's using them to find a legendary anaconda that's worth a fortune, if they can catch it.
programme.title: Anaconda

programme.desc: Fang-in-cheek tale about a single-parent family who move to the coastal town of Santa Clara where the local juvenile delinquents are actually a pack of vampires.
programme.title: The Lost Boys

programme.desc: Ash is transported back to medieval days, where he is captured by the dreaded Lord Arthur. Aided by the deadly chainsaw that has become his only friend, Ash is sent on a perilous mission to recover the Book of the Dead, a powerful tome that gives its owner the power to summon an army of ghouls.
programme.title: Army of Darkness

programme.desc: The Klingon Empire is falling apart, and they want peace with the Federation. However, when an unprotected Klingon craft is fired on, Kirk and Dr McCoy are placed on trial for murder.
programme.title: Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country

programme.desc: The maiden voyage of the third Starship Enterprise is jeopardised by mad scientist Soran. Only one man knows how to stop the boffin, but he's been dead 78 years.
programme.title: Star Trek Generations

programme.desc: This week's edition of the Cinema List is all about epic storytelling. From The Shawshank Redemption to Dunkirk, witness unforgettable tales of hope, courage and survival.
programme.title: The Cinema List: Epic Storytelling

programme.desc: Picard and his crew face a Borg offensive as they try to ensure that a 21st-century scientist keeps a date with destiny.
programme.title: Star Trek: First Contact

programme.desc: A Federation mission to the planet Ba'ku takes a dangerous turn when a malfunctioning android, Data, takes a cultural task force hostage. When Capt. Picard and his crew investigate, they uncover the truth about the Federation mission: It was actually a systematic ploy by the Son'a to displace the peaceful inhabitants of Ba'ku. Now Picard and his crew must thwart the plot even while experiencing strange side effects from exposure to the planet's surface.
programme.title: Star Trek: Insurrection

programme.desc: A reprogrammed killer cyborg arrives in Los Angeles to protect a future leader from a shape-shifting assassin.
programme.title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day

programme.desc: Humanity faces extinction after a giant comet is discovered heading for Earth. As a desperate mission is launched to stop it, families, leaders and ordinary people confront fear, sacrifice and survival as the countdown begins.

programme.desc: Doug Quaid has an ordinary life, although he dreams nightly of Mars - a planet he has never visited. Determined to find the meaning of these dreams, he visits Rekall Inc - a specialist in memory implants - intent on buying a memory trip to Mars, but the implant brings to the surface long-lost clues as to Quaid's true identity.
programme.title: Total Recall

programme.desc: Six years after defeating the Gremlins, Billy and Kate have grown up and moved to New York. However, Billy stumbles across Gizmo in a genetics lab and when he gets wet, all hell breaks loose, and the stage is set for more deliciously bad taste humour.
programme.title: Gremlins 2: The New Batch

programme.desc: Stanley Kubrick's take on the Vietnam War follows smart-aleck Private Davis, quickly christened 'Joker' by his foul-mouthed drill sergeant, and pudgy Private Lawrence, nicknamed 'Gomer Pyle', as they endure the rigours of basic training. Though Pyle takes a frightening detour, Joker graduates to the Marine Corps and is sent to Vietnam as a journalist, covering, and eventually participating in, the Battle of Hue.
programme.title: Full Metal Jacket

programme.desc: Young Jim has to grow up fast after the Japanese invade Shanghai. Separated from his parents and alone in a prisoner of war camp, Jim must fight to survive.
programme.title: Empire of the Sun

programme.desc: Bittersweet film about a gang of four 12-year-old boys growing up in Oregon in the 1950s. The story is told in flashback years afterwards by one of the boys - now a writer - and revolves around their search through the countryside around their hometown for the body of a missing teenager, thought to have been killed by a train. Adapted from 'The Body', a novella by Stephen King.
programme.title: Stand by Me

programme.desc: Classic Oscar-winning tough comedy adventure set in First World War Africa featuring a hard-drinking, woman-hating owner of the 'African Queen', a decrepit steamer that trades up and down the river, and a strait-laced spinster sister of missionary Rev Samuel Sayer, whom he has agreed to take back to civilisation.
programme.title: The African Queen

programme.desc: Visually exquisite biopic of Toulouse-Lautrec, the crippled painter whose work perfectly captured the spirit of bohemian Paris in the naughty 1890s. Portrayed as an embittered loner, he is tormented by his doomed relationships with prostitute Marie Charlet and sympathetic model Myriamme.
programme.title: Moulin Rouge

programme.desc: A sports agent who makes the mistake of saying what he believes finds himself sacked and abandoned by all his clients apart from small time footballer Rod Tidwell. Maguire's personal life starts to fall apart as he's torn between love and money in Cameron Crowe's metaphor on Americans' need for success and money.
programme.title: Jerry Maguire

Adapted from 'The Body', a novella by Stephen King.
programme.title: Stand by Me

programme.desc: A Secret Service agent-turned-bodyguard finds danger and romance while protecting an entertainer from a stalker.
programme.title: The Bodyguard

programme.desc: Drama about a gay lawyer's fight against unlawful dismissal by his homophobic employer. Forced to lead a double life because of the bigoted views held by his law firm, he discovers he is HIV-positive during a routine medical examination and is soon afterwards is fired for incompetence.
programme.title: Philadelphia

programme.desc: While widow Aurora fends off a stream of admirers, daughter Emma learns the hard facts of married life.
programme.title: Terms of Endearment

programme.desc: Andy Dufresne and Ellis Boyd 'Red' Redding are two prisoners serving long sentences in the vicious Shawshank jail. The two come to terms with their imprisonment while surviving the sadistic acts of prison warden Samuel Norton, and for both, a different sort of redemption awaits.
programme.title: The Shawshank Redemption

programme.desc: Paul Edgecomb, the head guard of death row, just wants life for him, his colleagues and the condemned to be nice and easy. However, when John Coffey, a massive man convicted of brutally killing a pair of young sisters, arrives, things start to get strange. Beyond his simple, naïve nature and a deathly fear of the dark, Coffey seems to possess a prodigious, supernatural gift. Paul begins to question whether Coffey was truly guilty of murdering the two girls.
programme.title: The Green Mile

programme.desc: The year is 1939, and England is at war. A passionate woman trapped inside a sterile marriage, Sarah Miles is immediately and irresistibly attracted to brooding novelist Maurice Bendrix when they meet at a party given by Sarah's worthy but unexciting civil servant husband, Henry. They begin a passionate, illicit and sexually liberating love affair.
programme.title: The End of the Affair

programme.desc: At the opening party of a colossal, but poorly constructed office building, a massive fire breaks out that threatens to destroy the tower and everyone in it.
programme.title: The Towering Inferno

programme.desc: An epic historical drama set in the 12th century in which Henry II summons his fragmented family to a reunion. There follows a series of battles, both political and personal, as his wife Eleanor and her three sons scheme to further their own claim to the king's empire.
programme.title: The Lion in Winter

programme.desc: Re-creation of the life of comic genius Charlie Chaplin, from his humble beginnings in south London through his early days in British vaudeville, his silent movie career in America and his late masterpieces. His turbulent personal life saw four marriages and an enforced exile from the US - though he returned to receive an honorary Oscar in 1972.
programme.title: Chaplin

programme.desc: Frederick Manion, an army lieutenant, is arrested for the murder of bartender Barney Quill. In defence, he claims that the victim had beaten and raped his wife. With such evidence somewhat lacking, Manion's lawyer, Paul Biegler attempts to save his defendant from prosecution, setting his assistants in search of witnesses.
programme.title: Anatomy of a Murder

programme.desc: A CIA agent comes up against a duplicitous American government during his quest to nab a Colombian drug lord.
programme.title: Clear and Present Danger

programme.desc: Andy Dufresne and Ellis Boyd 'Red' Redding are two prisoners serving long sentences in the vicious Shawshank jail. The two come to terms with their imprisonment while surviving the sadistic acts of prison warden Samuel Norton, and for both, a different sort of redemption awaits.
programme.title: The Shawshank Redemption

programme.desc: A violent and uncompromising police officer hunts for a psychopath who holds the city of San Francisco to ransom. Although the officer's unorthodox methods do not endear him to his superiors, the mayor reluctantly agrees that Harry Callahan seems to be the right cop for the job.
programme.title: Dirty Harry

programme.desc: Lavish thriller about an idealistic federal agent who vows to bring down Al Capone and his underworld crime syndicate in Prohibition-era Chicago. With police corruption rife, he forms a special team for the task and relies on a veteran street cop - passed over for promotion because he is honest - to clean up the force and trap Capone.
programme.title: The Untouchables

programme.desc: In an England of the future, Alex de Large is the leader of a gang of droogs whose pastime is violence, sex and murder, but whose eventual punishment is almost as extreme and violent as his crimes. Betrayed by the other members of his gang, he is arrested and offered an experimental treatment in order to shorten his sentence.
programme.title: A Clockwork Orange

programme.desc: An honest policeman is determined to bust police corruption and the stranglehold of the Mafia. At first, he innocently begins investigating the Mafia-related killing of a fellow officer, but things turn nasty when his wife is killed in a car bomb blast meant for him, his child is threatened with kidnapping and he loses his job.
programme.title: The Big Heat

programme.desc: Scary chiller about a coastal community plagued by a killer shark. With the summer tourist season at hand, the mayor is keen to keep the first attack hushed up. However, when an expert claims that the attacks are the work of a giant great white shark, there is only one solution - to kill the monster fish before it can feed again.
programme.title: Jaws

programme.desc: Another great white shark arrives to terrorise the holiday resort of Amity Island. Having recovered from the grisly events of four years ago, the island is once again packed with tourists. Families are sailing in the bay and swimming off the beach, but when two divers and a water-skier go missing, the local police chief fears that he is about to relive his greatest nightmare.
programme.title: Jaws 2

programme.desc: Second sequel to Steven Spielberg's 1970s blockbuster transports the action from Amity Island to a new undersea kingdom attraction in a Florida theme park. The capture of a baby great white shark is big news and brings crowds to the park - until its mother arrives on the scene.
programme.title: Jaws III

programme.desc: Henry Hill knows only too well that he must put the Mob's interests before everything, even his family, but when the good times turn sour, his loyalties dissolve in the face of greater rewards. Faced with a terrible retribution, Hill can see only one way to get out alive.
programme.title: Goodfellas

programme.desc: Detective Nick Curran is charged with finding out the truth after Catherine Tramell, a sensual bisexual writer, is suspected of murdering her lover with an ice pick, exactly the method used in one of her books. Unfortunately, he becomes too closely involved.
programme.title: Basic Instinct

programme.desc: Two wisecracking Miami cops are forced to swap identities in order to track down $100 million worth of heroin stolen from the police. Their only lead is a young woman who can identify the culprits, but when they track her down, she mistakes one of the cops for his partner, forcing the pair into a bizarre and chaotic life swap.
programme.title: Bad Boys

programme.desc: Epic tale in which an intrepid archaeologist tries to beat a band of Nazis to a unique religious relic which is central to their plans for world domination. Battling against a snake phobia and a vengeful ex-girlfriend, Indiana Jones is in constant peril, making hair's-breadth escapes at every turn in this celebration of the innocent adventure movies of an earlier era.
programme.title: Raiders of the Lost Ark

programme.desc: Adventure sequel. Intrepid archaeologist Indiana Jones, on the trail of fortune and glory in Old Shanghai, is ricocheted into a dangerous adventure in India. With his faithful companion Short Round and nightclub singer Willie Scott, Indie goes in search of the magical Sankara stone, and uncovers an ancient evil which threatens all who come into contact with it.
programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom

programme.desc: Sparks fly between an ambitious freelance reporter and a handsome firefighter after she lands a feel-good story about a Chicago Bears superfan who's about to attend her 500th game.
programme.title: Holiday Touchdown: A Bears Love Story

programme.desc: Disowned at birth by his wealthy family, Becket Redfellow will stop at nothing to reclaim his inheritance, no matter how many relatives stand in his way.
programme.title: How to Make a Killing

programme.desc: Framed for the murder of his billionaire boss, a vengeful man uncovers an international conspiracy as he battles a gang of thugs aboard a cargo ship.
programme.title: Mutiny

programme.desc: When a new Ghostface killer emerges in the quiet town where Sidney Prescott has built a new life, her darkest fears are realised as her daughter becomes the next target.
programme.title: Scream 7

programme.desc: Free Eden employee Apple secretly runs a witchy femme cult in the basement of a mall store after hours. When a new hire challenges their performative sisterhood, the women are forced to face their own poisons or succumb to a bloody fate.
programme.title: Forbidden Fruits

programme.desc: Two brothers and their adult children head to Ireland to honour their late father's final wish by scattering his ashes on a golf course. What starts as a clash of egos, old grudges and comic misadventures soon turns into a week of bonding and warmth.
programme.title: Finnegan's Foursome

programme.desc: S1 E3 — A Deadly Calling In Italy, Allied forces are stalled in the mountains south of Rome, unable to break through the German lines at Monte Cassino. The killing goes on all winter and spring as the enemy manages to fight off repeated Allied attacks. A risky landing at Anzio ends in utter failure; thousands of Allied troops, including Babe Ciarlo of Waterbury, are exposed to enemy fire and unable to advance for months.
programme.title: The War

programme.desc: Pride of Our Nation In the early hours of June 6, 1944 - D-Day - the invasion of France begins. A million and a half men take part. It is the bloodiest day in American history since the Civil War. The Allies succeed in tearing a 45-mile gap in Hitler's vaunted Atlantic Wall. By day's end more than 150,000 men have landed on French soil, and more men and more equipment and supplies are coming ashore every hour.
programme.title: The War

programme.desc: S1 — A Volunteer Basis In the summer of 1944 the Allies are bogged down in the hedgerows of Normandy, while in the Pacific, US Marines fight their costliest battle to date on the island of Saipan. By mid-August, the Germans are in full retreat out of France, and on 25 August, after four years of Nazi occupation, Paris is liberated.
programme.title: The War

programme.desc: S1 E5 — FUBAR By September 1944 on the Western Front, American and British troops massed on the German border are desperately short of fuel. Allied commanders gamble on a risky scheme to drop thousands of airborne troops behind enemy lines in Holland, In the Pacific, General MacArthur is poised to invade the Philippines at Leyte. The fighting drags on for more than two months in one of the most brutal and unnecessary campaigns in the Pacific.

programme.title: A Christmas Carol

programme.desc: A gadget salesman is looking for a special gift for his son and finds one at a store in Chinatown. The shopkeeper is reluctant to sell him the 'mogwai' but sells it to him with the warning to never expose him to bright light, water, or to feed him after midnight. All of this happens and the result is a gang of gremlins that decide to tear up the town on Christmas Eve.
programme.title: Gremlins

programme.desc: The Grinch and his loyal dog, Max, live a solitary existence inside a cave on Mount Crumpet. His main source of aggravation comes during Christmastime when his neighbours in Whoville celebrate the holidays with a bang. When the Whos decide to make Christmas bigger and brighter, the disgruntled Grinch realises there is one way to gain peace and quiet. With help from Max, the green grump hatches a scheme to pose as Santa Claus, steal Christmas and silence the Whos' holiday cheer once and for all.
programme.title: The Grinch

programme.desc: Shunned by the relentlessly happy citizens of Whoville, the Grinch retreats to his gloomy lair on Mt Crumpit.
